agreement.source: Explicit user acceptance of the proposed thresholds in this session

deferred.full_cold_start: NOT_MEASURED; only executable file-page residency is controlled here
deferred.production_first_frame: NOT_MEASURED; M7/M8 requires controlled synthetic bootstrap filesystem/OS environment

environment.host_load: Shared interactive host; load observations retained; no claim of exclusive or thermally fixed hardware
environment.thermal: Per-build before/after observations retained in raw evidence

method.build: Release target ansa only, BUILD_TESTING=OFF, -j2, pinned GCC, compiler launcher disabled; configure separate; empty build trees with warm toolchain/filesystem cache
method.build_rss: GNU time max individual process high-water and 20ms sampled sum of owned descendants across Ninja job groups; shared pages double-counted; sampled aggregate is a lower bound, not exact physical RAM peak
method.cache: Warm after one warmup; cold means only owned executable file pages were proven nonresident with mincore; dependency and other OS caches are not controlled cold
method.cli_rss: Separate GNU time 1.10 child high-water samples, excludes Python pre-exec floor; runtime_maxrss_bytes only
method.cli_wall: Direct process launch to pidfd exit readiness; Popen/pidfd overhead included; wait4/reaping excluded; safe CLI forms only
method.incremental: One-comment source edit in main.cpp; each raw log confirms compilation and relink; compare with equivalent entrypoint edit in Rust
method.matching: Compare release with release on same hardware, jobs, cache protocol, workloads and measurement adapters; warm/cold and RSS/timing series stay separate
method.samples: Wall warm 50/cold 20 per CLI; RSS warm 20/cold 10 per CLI; clean builds 3; incremental edits 9
method.statistics: Median/p95-nearest-rank/max retained; n=3/9 builds give descriptive order statistics, not a statistically established tail

policy.build_wall: Maximum clean <= 2 * baseline maximum; incremental <= 3 * baseline maximum; rounded up to 0.1s
policy.cli_latency: p95 <= max(1.5 * baseline p95, baseline p95 + 5ms), rounded up to 1ms
policy.cli_rss: Maximum <= max(1.25 * baseline maximum, baseline maximum + 4MiB), rounded up to 1MiB
policy.correctness: Resource allowances never relax correctness, replay, cancellation or safety limits; no silent budget increases before comparison
policy.engineering_ceilings: Installed binary 16MiB, strip-all binary 8MiB, closure 96MiB and build RSS 2GiB are user-approved ceilings, not statistically derived regression estimates. They allow Rust/static-dependency headroom while bounding total footprint and native -j2 build cost.

rust_scaffold: No runtime/performance parity claim. tests/parity/run.py perf remains unimplemented/nonzero in M0.
